about: Proposed region definition for a detailed map of Costa Rica, as one region for the whole country (mainland box), with the 7 provinces listed as an alternative and the Gran Area Metropolitana as a possible separate grouping. A proposal for discussion (docs/REGIONS-CR.md); no code reads this file, and it does not ship.

codes.why: A bare CR collides with no US code in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py line 26).
codes.alternative: ISO 3166-2:CR: CR-SJ San Jose, CR-A Alajuela, CR-C Cartago, CR-H Heredia, CR-G Guanacaste, CR-P Puntarenas, CR-L Limon.
codes.warning: OCHA COD-AB p-codes CR1 to CR7 run San Jose, Alajuela, Cartago, Heredia, Guanacaste, Puntarenas, Limon, which is not the ISO letter order. Join by name.
codes.verified: The ISO 3166-2 codes were not checked against the ISO site (general knowledge).

regions.name: Costa Rica

box_source.dataset: OCHA COD-AB Costa Rica (cri_admin0.geojson / cri_admin1.geojson), source INEC (National Statistics Office), valid_on 2024-12-03, HDX record last modified 2026-08-14
box_source.rule: Extent of every vertex, minus/plus 0.15 degrees (the margin of map_sets.state in derived/packs/pack-spec.json), rounded outward to 0.01 degrees.

isla_del_coco.rule_for_split: Polygons of COD-AB level 0 whose easternmost vertex is west of 86 degrees W (computed).
isla_del_coco.recommendation: Mainland box for CR; Isla del Coco noted as left out, or a separate tiny box. Undecided.

regions.area_source: area_sqkm attribute of COD-AB level 0 (includes Isla del Coco)
regions.area_note: The official figure is about 51,100 km2 (general knowledge).
regions.clip: Geofabrik's extract is cut outside the border and includes Isla del Coco, so a first build holds some neighbouring land; how much was not measured. Suggested: the border as the edge of a first build, a band later. Undecided.
regions.neighbours_in_box: General knowledge, not measured. Nicaragua: Rivas department, south shore of Lake Nicaragua, south of Rio San Juan department. Panama: a strip along the border (Chiriqui, west tip of Bocas del Toro). The rest is sea.

disputed_boundary.place: Northern part of Isla Portillos (about 3 km2), at the Caribbean mouth of the San Juan River
disputed_boundary.icj_2015: Judgment of 2015-12-16, 14 votes to 2: Costa Rica has sovereignty over the disputed territory; Nicaragua's dredging of canos and military presence violated it. Harbor Head Lagoon is agreed to be Nicaraguan. (opened: ICJ summary)
disputed_boundary.icj_2018: Judgment of 2018-02-02: Costa Rica has sovereignty over the whole northern part of Isla Portillos including its coast, except Harbor Head Lagoon and the sandbar separating it from the sea. (search only)
disputed_boundary.cod_ab: District Colorado (Pococi, Limon) has vertices up to 10.9424 N (computed); whether its edge follows the 2018 line was not checked.

alternative_regions.about: If finer regions are wanted. The Central Valley sits where the San Jose, Alajuela, Heredia and Cartago boxes meet, so one province's box holds much of the others' land.

gam.about: Gran Area Metropolitana as a possible separate grouping with its own id (for example CR-GAM; the id is the maintainers' choice), not a province code that means more than the province.
gam.plan: Plan Regional de Ordenamiento Territorial de la GAM, Plan GAM 2013-2030, approved by the Consejo Nacional de Planificacion Urbana on 2014-01-20; Decreto 38145 (a regulation 38334-H/2014 also appears) (search only, CEPAL Plataforma Urbana).
gam.publisher: INVU, Direccion de Urbanismo, and the Council's secretariat follow its execution (search only).
gam.cantons_note: Partial, from a truncated search excerpt; the full list was not read.
gam.download: None found. The Atlas Digital del Plan GAM 2013 (83 maps, 172 layers) is listed in the TEC repository (search only). INVU page tried: 404; CEPAL page: 403.
gam.box_note: Not computed: the canton list is not confirmed. Option 1: union of the plan's cantons from COD-AB level 2 (CC BY-IGO). Option 2: the plan's own polygon, which needs INVU permission.

addressing.style: Directions from a landmark, in metres or blocks: 'De la pulperia La Chanchita, 400 al este, 200 al sur y 25 al norte' (opened, 1997 La Nacion column); 'De la Iglesia de Zapote 200 mts al Sur' (search only). Most addresses have no street name or number.
addressing.postcode: Five digits: province (1), canton (2), district (2); 30502 = La Suiza, Turrialba, Cartago (opened, La Nacion 2009 and Wikipedia). 492 districts in COD-AB vs 492 codes in one search result (another database: 487). Dates conflict: La Nacion page dated 2009-04-28, Wikipedia says introduced March 2013. How widely used: not found.
addressing.engine: \d{5} (engine/address_search.py line 65) accepts the five digits but they mean a district, not a US ZIP. _parts() expects a house number as the first word. normalize() keeps only a-z, 0-9 and spaces: 'Perez Zeledon' with accents becomes 'p rez zeled n' (regex run 2026-11-18). Folding is needed; see related.pr_79.
